description.zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

- 由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

- 由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

- 长度为2~120个字符。
description.en:
The name of the IP whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or digit.

- It must be 2 to 120 characters in length.
The ID of the IP whitelist template.

description.zh: 地域ID，您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~61933~~)接口查询。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
